description: MammothOS MCP server registry. Each entry maps to a config file in this directory. Set enabled=false to disable without removing the config.

servers.label: Browser (Playwright)
servers.description: Headed Chromium automation with persistent auth profile. Provides navigate, snapshot, click, fill, screenshot, and extract tools.

servers.label: Filesystem (Repo)
servers.description: Read/write access to the MammothOS repo root. Allows Mammoth Mind to inspect and edit project files. Secrets are denied.

servers.label: Git
servers.description: Git status, diff, log, and branch inspection. Commit/push require human approval gate.
